mapper.insert: insert into emergency_contact(elder_id, name, phone, email, relation, receive_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{elderId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{relation}, #{receiveFlag}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from emergency_contact where elder_id = #{elderId} order by create_time desc
